name: pscat
description: PostScript rendering, generative art and paper-ready charts with the pscat interpreter: three skills plus the pscat-mcp server. Requires pscat installed separately.

hooks.command: command -v pscat >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v pscat-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "pscat plugin: pscat / pscat-mcp not found on PATH, so the pscat MCP tools will not start. Install them: cargo install --git https://github.com/jeromebanks/postscript_interpreter (or a release binary from https://github.com/jeromebanks/postscript_interpreter/releases), then restart Claude Code."}'
